video_title: Does OKC NEED a Trade to Help SGA? Marc Stein on Jalen Williams & Cason Wallace Injuries

quotes.speaker: Marc Stein
quotes.summary_phrase: Oklahoma City Thunder's flexibility to make roster moves
quotes.excerpt: they have the optionality to do it, they have the assets to do it
quotes.quote: They might and they might not. I think we do have to wait and see. They have the optionality to do it, they have the assets to do it. They have trade exceptions, they have seven tradeable first-round picks, they have 21 seconds. If they want to make moves, they can. And even though they are seven million away from the second apron, they are not hard capped so they can actually go past it. They have the ability to react and I think they will be very measured in how this proceeds.

quotes.speaker: Marc Stein
quotes.summary_phrase: The difficulty of replacing Jalen Williams' production
quotes.excerpt: you can't replace Jalen Williams. There's no who are you going to go get that can do what he does
quotes.quote: You can't replace Jalen Williams. There's no who are you going to go get that can do what he does. And they have to keep an eye on their long-term finances. I don't think they rush out. They have the ability to react and I think they will be very measured in how this proceeds because there's an emotional toll to this as well. It's not just the basketball, it's not just the losses of these guys on the court.

quotes.speaker: Marc Stein
quotes.summary_phrase: Cason Wallace's injury and the rarity of in-season labrum tears
quotes.excerpt: The only in-season return from a labrum tear in his file since 2005 is Nicola Batum in 2009
quotes.quote: Cason Wallace, that injury is serious too. We had the stat yesterday from the great Jeff Stotts of In Street Clothes. Jeff keeps all the data on every injury in the NBA. The only in-season return from a labrum tear in his file since 2005 is Nicola Batum in 2009. So only one, that also happened in late October when it happened with Batum. So is there time for Wallace to make it back? I guess theoretically.

quotes.speaker: Marc Stein
quotes.summary_phrase: The uncertainty surrounding Jalen Williams' return to form
quotes.excerpt: I don't know if there's a bridge. You're a bridge to whatever is left when he does recover
quotes.quote: Whatever this deal is, fine. But I don't know if there's a bridge. This is why I asked the question earlier right off the top is you mentioned on Monday you're not sure Jalen Williams will ever be back the way he was. And that's why I don't know if you're a bridge to what was, you're a bridge to whatever is left when he does recover from this injury.

quotes.speaker: Marc Stein
quotes.summary_phrase: Comparing Jalen Williams' injury trajectory to Gordon Hayward
quotes.excerpt: The comparison was and I think it was an apt one was with what Gordon Hayward went through
quotes.quote: The comparison was and I think it was an apt one was with what Gordon Hayward went through. Also obviously very early in the season when he hurt his. There were side-by-side pictures the other night. It was exactly the same. And actually a doctor basically predicted exactly what this injury was going to be once they diagnosed it and he was 100% right. And you and I talked about Gordon Hayward's trajectory of his career. He made it back like two years later and had a very good year, but he had just been an All-Star prior to the injury. He never made the All-Star game again and then he started missing 20 to 30 games a year every year after that and he retired at 33 years old.

quotes.speaker: Marc Stein
quotes.summary_phrase: Herb Jones as a potential trade target for Oklahoma City
quotes.excerpt: I imagine that Herb Jones's name will be suggested as a dream target
quotes.quote: I imagine that Herb Jones's name will be suggested as a dream target. And look again, the Thunder have picks galore to offer because teams have been trying to pilfer for Herb Jones from the Pelicans for ages now. And New Orleans last season basically was telling teams, trade Trey Murphy and Herb Jones if they are not untouchable, it's pretty dang close. You're going to have to offer us three firsts for Trey Murphy or two firsts for Herb Jones.

quotes.speaker: Marc Stein
quotes.summary_phrase: The Thunder's past financial sacrifices to maintain team trajectory
quotes.excerpt: they ended up having to trade Lou Dort and Aaron Wiggins and Isaiah Joe
quotes.quote: I don't think they wanted to trade Lou Dort. They ended up having to trade Lou Dort and Aaron Wiggins and Isaiah Joe just to be able to extend Cason Wallace and put the team, keep the team going on the trajectory they are. And so you've got to factor in that too. Long-term finances is something that they have to keep their eye on.
